How to apply
Prior to submitting your application we would always recommend discussing with us your chosen area of research.
Speak to either the relevant member of our academic staff or the Postgraduate Admissions Team. We would also recommend applying through the University's online application system as early in the academic year as possible - this will allow enough time for external funding and visa applications and approvals.
